data: A beautiful game and worth every penny
The best Game of my life, beatiful arts, perfect soundtrack, and an emotional environment
Overall: 9/10 ⭐ Story: 9/10 ⭐ Gameplay: 10/10 ⭐ Atmosphere: 10/10 ⭐ Graphics: 10/10 ⭐ Audio: 10/10 ⭐ Performance: 10/10 ⭐ Replayability: 7/10
Amazing storyline, stunning graphics, beautiful music, satisfying gameplay, slightly challenging
the utterly boring and repetitive gameplay loop ruined it all for me
the whole game also just feels extremely sluggish, both controlling the character and just basic platforming just did not feel good at all to me
as a game, I cannot recommend it since it doesn't really have any real engaging gameplay
the story feels boring , gameplay is almost absent, and the exploration was frustrating especially the second half of the game
gameplay is weak and boring, puzzles are not rewarding to complete
They focused too much on looking artsy and forgot to make the graphics work with gameplay
The elements you can jump on or go through like walls or columns don't visually indicate if you can jump or pass through
If you were bought with visual
And don't get me wrong, the story is deep and heartbreaking
, I think it lacks something major: narrative context
There are no dialogues or written explanations to give the player context, leaving much of the story open to interpretation

if you're into games as art, this one is amazing, i put it up there with journey

little to no dialogue, definition of show don't tell, the art is absolutely gorgeous, music is serene and calm

made me emotional and im not even sure why

What a lovely indie game. Gris is a haunting and atmospheric adventure that takes you through the five stages of grief , with an amazing soundtrack that tickled my composer brain in the best way. Modular synths, strings, piano and choir are a match made in heaven.

Anyway, I’d definitely recommend Gris as long as you don’t mind getting through the first chapter, which can feel a little slow. And the game is fairly short. 4 hours ish. But it does go on sale regularly so there’s that.

Overall score: 9/10
Very good. No ragrets.

PS: Be prepared to press F12 many times. The graphics and art style are gorgeous

Straight into my top 3 absolute best games I have ever played. It's a game, but it's also art, therapy, and life supply for anyone who has ever lived through something dark. This is the kind of game we need more of. Passion projects that turn into magic.

Stunningly gorgeous, this game is just as engrossing to watch as it is to play. It really makes for a perfect gentle activity. Even when I start a sesh feeling really tired and drained, the soothing animation, peaceful ambient sound and clever game design make me feel curious, lighter, and refreshed. I hope the game developers are very proud of their work <3

Such a pretty world, with music to match! The art and music really sets the tone.
Recommend not rushing through the game. Take it in, wander and discover. Not a long game, but that's a good thing. Made it less intimidating for me to start playing

Played it in one sitting 4 hrs 36 min and really took my time. Normal completion time is probably 3 1/2 hrs
The beautiful art- and sound design will leave players with a sense of wonder while they explore the mysterious world of Gris. Chill platformer with replay value for some.

For most of this game, I didn't know what I was supposed to do. But I knew that as long as I was reaching new places and gaining new abilities, I was probably on the right track.
This sentiment is so unique to grief that it is beyond surprising that a game could so accuratly convey it. It's about being lost and overwhelmed yet gradualy findinding ways of interacting with the enviroment until it gains its colors again. You don't have clear objectives because those aren't real. All you have is what you feel, what you can do and the world.
Beatiful and necessary.

You aren't buying a game. You're buying tickets to an art museum. 

I don't know how to elaborate on the good parts of this game without opening a thesaurus and looking up "pretty."

The collectibles suck, though. Just look up a guide if you want to find them all AFTER beating the game. 

9/10

An exquisite game about finding beauty within what is broken, in which the only stakes are your own curiosity and the only reward is peace of heart.

Have you ever wanted to heal your mind and soul by wandering through a vast and intricate world of puzzles, with the refreshing, calming visual style like that of a children's picture book, while immersed in a gorgeous, seamless soundtrack? Then this is the game for you <3

Beautiful game ♥ The art/visuals and sound design are wonderful. Puzzles are well designed and entertaining, you don't ever feel like its a chore. Very emotional even though not a single word is spoken, so good!!

Beautiful soundtrack, aesthetics, imagery, and graphics. Its packed with so much emotion and metaphor yet wonderfully executed and again so beautiful!! Absolutely one of my favorite games :) I usually never play through games more than once but I have played this a few times through ^^ I had played this game from someone else's library but I loved it so much I got it for my own library.

This game is beautiful no other way to describe it. From the beginning to the end I was mesmerised by just how picturesque all of the environments are. The gameplay is simple but its obviously not the driving point, its the experience of going through the areas and piecing together the message of the game. I Highly recommend it, the game is not long so you can finish it in one sitting. Its an amazing bite sized experience.
Perfect art design, perfect sound design, perfect level design, perfect story telling, everything is just perfect

The game is visually appealing, it does not give answers to all the puzzles outright, the music is very relaxing and calming so even if you are frustrated with the game it never really gets to a point of being worked up about it.

This game sat in my wishlist for at least a year. When I finally was able to buy it, i didn't realized how much I needed this game. It literally brought me back from the end of a long fraying rope. This is the most beautiful game I have ever played, and has become my favorite game of any others.

This is one of the most beautiful games I've ever played in my entire life and if you don't check it out, you're missing out. The soundtrack, visuals, story line, game play, etc; everything in this game is astounding. I literally cried when it ended cause it gave me chills and I didn't want the game to end ( gonna replay to unlock all the achievements ). Honestly, give it a try. Highly recommend this to ANYONE and everyone, 100% worth every penny <3
What a beautiful experience. This game can take you to a wonderful emotional adventure. And If you a fan of the creative gameplay and unque animations, you have to play it!

I have never written a review but GRIS is absolutely worth to start with.
The graphics are phenomenal. The aquarelle graphic style is beautiful and it feels like every pixel and every object is exactly where it belongs to.
The Soundtrack is on point and one of the best I've ever heard in a game.
The game has so much to say without saying it because it will tell you it's story with the visuals and the soundtrack (I have repeat myself: visuals and soundtrack are absolutely wonderful).
Gris herself is such an adorable character.

The game itself is quite easy and slow paced. So if you are looking for a challenging or fast paced game this might not be it.
But you are here anyway so I highly recommend to give it a try.
Also the game has a short playtime of 3-4 hours.
I really enjoyed this game. I even enjoyed the credits.

Summary:
Is the game worth 16.99€ for 3-4 hours? Yes!
Will I play this game a second, third, ... time? Definitively yes.
Do I recommend this game? Absolutely.

The art and OST is so perfect. Every scene is Desktop background worthy. Nothing too difficult where it would repel the player. Honestly, it was like the game gave me a slight breeze and i let it carry me through the story. 15/10

A very beautifully designed game with great artwork, sound design and music. There's a message in there that you can choose for yourself. I'm not going to tell you how to feel. 

It's not short, it's about the correct length. If you're coming to it without playing a lot of other 2D platformers it might take longer.

A wonderful game from start to finish, a journey of recovery from a loss .

This game's main task is to be beautiful - and it excels at it.

It's a truly relaxing, almost meditative experience. Level design guides you without patronising, thus making every step of the game sincerely enjoyable. Visual marvel with superb sound design and soundtrack, something everyone should enjoy.
A beautiful game with a great sound design. More of an experience than a traditional game. I really enjoyed it. Especially to relax to.

Beautiful, peaceful, relaxing game. Abstractly play through a story about navigating the stages of grief and regaining your voice. Amazing art and music, simple gameplay, and decent puzzles make this game a wonderful way to spend a few hours.

Hands-down one of the most beautiful art styles I've encountered. I really enjoyed Gris.

Good quick game about a girl who is going through loss and trying to find her footing in an unknown situation. Going through the main stages of grief and going from a grey world to a stunning colorful one filled with wonder. I honestly didn't know what kind of game it was, turned out it was a platformer. Though the main reason to buy it is the art direction. It's not my cup of tea per say, but I get why people like it and praise it.

A Beautiful game through and through. The use of color and motion was breath taking at points, and the music and sound design was masterful. It was very easy to be immersed in the game.

Gameplay wise, it's a very casual platformer, with some fun and interesting mechanics and gimmicks that matched the environment of the different sections of the game.

If you are looking for a casual gameplay experience with some gorgeous visuals and immersive soundtrack this is it.

A Masterpiece called GRIS

Gris is a game about a lady that is grieving. The reason why, is not known, which allows the player to analyze and understand the event, depending on their experiences. Gris makes a long journey through her fears and difficulties, going through the stages of grief (denial, anger, bargaining, depression, acceptance).
She loses her voice, her world collapses; it becomes white and black and so does she. The extra weight she is carrying becomes her weapon. Through that journey she becomes more and more powerful, so her world is gradually turning colorful.
I like the fact that she doesn’t fight back against her fears, her demons; she’s only trying to run away from them or to stand up to them - to endure them. But in her own way, she beats them.
The scenery is breathtaking. Simple, surreal yet believable. Without any unnecessary information, to the point where one might think that there is something missing, some sort of deficiency, but no. This way it stays real, and it is creating a very calming environment. No need to rush, so you can enjoy the graphics.
Gris is a masterpiece!

Quand poésie et onirisme croise le chemin du jeu vidéo; on obtient ce genre de pépite. Une bande son qui vous donnera des frissons et un level design qui ne cessera de vous émerveiller. Le gameplay, facile à prendre en main, vous fera voyager au travers d'énigmes et d'univers tous différents mais parfaitement aboutis.
Le genre de jeu qu'on aime déjà sans même y avoir jouer.
Trop court, oui, mais toute les bonnes choses ont une fin...

This is the most beautiful game I've ever played and, arguably, will ever play. It's the perfect game for me in all aspects.

From the artwork to the vague yet interest-piquing storyline, it brings so many emotions when playing it. The music plays a huge part in this too. Everything blends together perfectly and I couldn't recommend this enough.

I did a blind playthrough on my stream and it was seamless, too. The only minor complaint I could make is that there is no 'Settings' tab in the main menu, and is only visible when you start a game.

It's gripping and wonderful to play, all without any subtitles or text other than when you gain a new ability. I love it here.

persevere through an empty world to find your voice again and find strength in spite of solitude. a unique take on defeating one's inner enemies. without a word of dialogue, GRIS manages to be beautifully profound. the soundtrack and visuals drove me to tears a couple of times. i cannot recommend it enough.

One of the most beautiful video games I've played. The soundtrack was amazing for creating an excellent atmosphere. Play this alone and without distraction. Lighthearted platforming and puzzle solving makes this game easy to relax with.

This was art, would recommend 10/10

A journey into the 5 stages of grief, Gris is a relaxing platformer that says a lot, without ever saying anything to you, while touching one of the hardest subjects.
With interesting puzzles and mechanics, well introduced and developed, Gris sets the atmosphere with stunning animation in its hand-drawn meets watercolor art style, while the amazing soundtrack sets the mood.
An amazing, experience, one that found me fighting the urge to take a screenshot of everything.
Short but stunning. I could not suggest it more, seriously.
8/10
This game exceeded my expectations. It's stunningly beautiful. The gameplay reminds me of Limbo. The puzzles are not too difficult and it's fun to explore.

Hey, I played your game at PAX and I didnt get it but you lead me through, it was beautiful then and it is beautiful now. I love your game in a completely different way than I love anything else. Thank you <3

The most beautiful looking game I've ever played. It's not very challenging for a platformer, but it has the best graphics and some of the best music I've ever seen in a game. One of the few games to ever make me cry.

Gris is a very simple platformer and in terms of gameplay alone, it's rather bland. The exquisite soundtrack and the uniquely beautiful artwork are what make the game a pleasure to spend time with. Personally I didn't get any of the 'feels' that the game tries to invoke, but I imagine that side of the game will be polarising in that some will feel it very strongly, while others will not. A relaxing and peaceful experience which deserves praise for it's originality.

Truly a visual masterpiece filled with great music. Everything all the way from subtle details that let you figure out the story on your own to the simplest of sound effects make this game one in a lifetime experience for me. The gameplay is very straightforward and the game doesn't take too long to beat (roughly 3-4 hours, took me 8 with all the achievements).

If you are looking to try something different, since this kind of a game isn't common enough I believe, definitely give this one a try. Unfortunately due to length of the game I am having a hard time recommending it for a full price. If you have money to spare then feel free to buy it for the full price, if not it might be better to wait for a sale, either way I think you will get your money worth just from the experience alone.

A breathtaking game full of stunning landscapes, brilliant platforming movement puzzles, fantastic visuals, and a deeply soothing soul enriching soundtrack.

Don't snooze on this one, it's a cracker!
SO gorgeous and relaxing. The puzzles are super fun to figure out, and the fun little friends are very cute.
This game is a walking sim about surviving grief. Not worth it as a game, but worth it as a reminder to survive grief. This reminder will be very useful in the coming years.

This game... I swear...
This entire game was such an incredibly emotional ride for me. The artwork and music is phenomenal, but the truth is that's just the surface; it was the symbolism behind everything that literally drove me to tears, and is what in my opinion makes this game one of the most memorable and rewarding games I have ever played, and likely ever will play.
Since finishing this 100 percent I have recommended this to just about all of my friends, and if you are reading this I hope you buy it too. I am confident that you won't be disappointed, even if at the very least just at surface value. :)

Like many other atmospheric games, GRIS is an example of beautiful animation, a stellar soundtrack, subtle storytelling and unremarkable gameplay. It's a shame that many games striving to make an emotional or artistic statement fail to utilise the span of their chosen platform, and GRIS is no different. This game is about a girl in a trying, difficult place in her life. At no point is the game trying or difficult. At no point are you GRIS -- you just get to watch her.

GRIS is exactly what it sets out to be: a good story in a forgettable game. If you're interested in the story, the world or the soundtrack, I recommend picking it up. If you're interested in a game that lets you *feel* an emotional struggle, I suggest you pick up Celeste instead.

You don't die...
you don't level up(you do get some abilities as part of story)...
puzzles are simple...

if you are going in thinking of it as a typical game you'll be disappointed..

But...
if you just wanna chill and go on a small but beautiful journey...

This is the one

First of all I would like to admit I pirated this game when it launched, it was probably the only time i felt like I stole something. I was broke and I bought the game in the end.
This is one of my favorite games and what I got from this game may not be what you get. I think others said enough about how beautiful the game looks and how good it sounds,
I am very emotionally attached to GRIS so I would just like to say that this is master class in non verbal story telling.
A masterpiece that everyone should experience.

I don't even know where to start... This game is DEEP! The animation, the symbolisms, the designs, and most specially the MUSIC!!! Everything abt this game is Amazing! It doesn't have dialogues nor words, you have to interpretate everything that you see which makes you and this game create a deeper connection. It doesn't tell you where to go nor what to do, you'll just know. I was admiring this game the whole ride. This game didn't say anything but it sure hell showed and made you feel everything. I finished it in just one sitting and ILUVIT!!!

One of the most beautiful and cathartic games I've ever played. Simple enough mechanics that I can recommend it to loved ones who do not play games, but still a satisfying experience for any skill level. Beautiful music, art, and visual storytelling. Strongly recommended.

Gorgeous art style, compelling story despite lack of dialogue, gameplay is smooth and not too difficult which I think is ideal for more story-driven games like this one. The achievments were all very fun, nothing was too tedious, I really like how you keep all your collectibles even when jumping from chapter to chapter. Overall it's an amazing game.

This game is one of the most beautiful games I have ever played.
The visuals are breath-taking, sometimes I will just run around in game just to try and take in its beauty.

The game play is simple, but sometimes a little frustrating as you are basically left to try and figure out what to do on your own.

10/10 visuals
8/10 game play
8/10 story line
10/10 would recommend

There is no doubt that the art style of Gris is absolutely stunning, and because of that, I got interested in playing this game. I didn't have expectations about it; I just wanted to experience it myself. Personally, I did not enjoy some of the puzzles; they were slow and tedious (in my opinion). My curiosity is what kept me going to complete the game.
Gris gives you the possibility to explore different areas in-game even after completing the story, giving you the chance to spend more time in it. However, it is not something I am willing to invest time on.
I think that if you are someone that enjoys slow-paced games with some puzzles, good art style and music, I would recommend giving it a try and see if it's a game for you.

I think this is the most visually stunning game I have played. Each area continued to surprise me in how beautiful it was, and how well it represented its own ideas. The music, sound design, and the way the character feels to play are also all perfect for characterising each emotion.

Only the story itself didn't emotionally resonate with me as much as I'm sure it will for some others, but even then I can see so much beauty and passion in it.

Stunning, 200% art.
I love that there's no dying in this game, by connecting this design with the plot, it conveys that we can overcome any hardships with practice and time. Thus gives me a heart-warming courage. Looking forward to more unique games with female protagonists.
We will eventually reconcile with pain.

tldr.text: Very Positive (95%): players praise the art and the music.
9% of reviews complain about the gameplay, with some calling it repetitive.

details.text: 8% of recent reviews complain about the art, against 4% of all reviews, and one says the developers "forgot to make the graphics work with gameplay".
Players who review within their first two hours are 73% positive, while longer-time players are notably more positive.
